Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaSibugay(Siay, Payao, Alicia, Tungawan), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dimataling, Pitogo, Tabina), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(DatuBlahT.Sinsuat), #DinagatIslands(SanJose, Dinagat), #SurigaoDelNorte(Placer, Gigaquit, Bacuag), #ZamboangaCity, #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, DapitanCity, DipologCity, Katipunan, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas), #Basilan(CityOfLamitan, Akbar, Tuburan, HadjiMohammadAjul), #SultanKudarat(Lebak, Kalamansig, Palimbang, Bagumbayan, Isulan) and #Sarangani(Maitum) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SultanKudarat(Sen.NinoyAquino), #DinagatIslands(Cagdianao), #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, TaganaAn), #ZamboangaSibugay(Talusan, Olutanga and Mabuhay) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
